releaseNotes: v8.22.15: Database query throttling and background pre-decoding optimizations inspired by Chimanew architecture. Added lightweight bookshelf summary projections (getAllNovelsSummary) and indexed title lookups to eliminate full chapter text heap thrashing, background pre-parsing of adjacent chapters (prefetchAround) via idle callbacks with an LRU cache, async off-thread image decoding and lazy loading across bookshelf covers and illustrations, Calibre CSS sanitization, and OPF publication date extraction.
